Welcome to the Nextflow Crash Course, a series of hands-on workshops introducing pipeline development and execution with [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/).

## Who this course is for

You're comfortable on the command line and have written a bash script or two, but Nextflow is new to you. By the end of the workshop, you'll have built a modular, multi-step DSL2 pipeline and run it on the Hazel cluster using SLURM and Apptainer containers.

*Nextflow fundamentals*

Your first process, building channels with channel factories and operators, and chaining processes into a FastQC + trimming workflow.

#### Day 2 · From Pipeline to Production

*Config, modules, containers, and the cluster*

Params, `nextflow.config`, and profiles; modular processes with `include`; Apptainer containers; SLURM execution; and a read-assembly capstone.

Work through the Day 0 material before Day 1. The workshop assumes you can log in, load modules, and submit a SLURM job.
:::
